item.title: @thejayalto: one of the greatest life hacks out there is shifting your sleep one hour earlier. if you go to bed at 11pm and get up at
item.description: one of the greatest life hacks out there is shifting your sleep one hour earlier. if you go to bed at 11pm and get up at 7am, just start going to bed at 10pm and getting up at 6am. that 'early' hour is worth at least three 'late' ones.
item.content:encoded:
@thejayalto

one of the greatest life hacks out there is shifting your sleep one hour earlier. if you go to bed at 11pm and get up at 7am, just start going to bed at 10pm and getting up at 6am. that 'early' hour is worth at least three 'late' ones.
